_note: Body expression (pepin.expression): the gesture engine and the speaker gaze, run inside the voice cascade on the laptop. The atoms, compositions, taught poses and idle layers are config/animation.json; the arm's caps, limits and rest pose, which the board enforces, are config/arm.json's motion block; the face finder's detector is config/face_sensor.json's. Every number here is a design default until a line says MEASURED.

flags.note: The two features' switches at the cascade's start; while it runs: scripts/voice_cascade.py switch --flag gestures=on (data/voice/control.json's flags, answered in control.jsonl). Switching a feature on re-reads this file and config/animation.json. gestures: every gesture and idle layer of every part (arm, head overlays, face cues, wheels); off, markers are still taken out of the speech and nothing moves. speaker_gaze: the head's base layer on the person and its turn of the wheels.

timing.note: audio_lag_s: how much later the speaker sounds than the player's clock says a block plays (the board's aplay start, config/face.json's lipsync start_latency_s 0.12, unmeasured, plus the WiFi hop): a cue fires this much later. char_s: seconds per spoken character while a part's audio is still being made (Player.heard's estimate).

layers.note: fade_s: every change between layers on a part (a gesture taken over, the gesture layer faded when the person starts speaking). idle_resume_s: quiet on a part after a gesture before its idle layer plays again. seed: null draws a fresh seed for each performance (logged with it); a number makes every performance repeat (the bench).

arm.note: latency_s: the WiFi hop and the board's next tick. speed_scale: every arm clip's time stretched by 1/speed_scale and the servos' profile capped by it; 0.2 for the first live test, raised by Artem's word. knot_hz: the knots a clip is sampled into (the board interpolates between them on its 50 Hz tick).

head.note: latency_s: the door's HTTP, the arbiter's step and the neck_target hop. fade_s: a head overlay let go (POST /release's fade_s) returns to the holder's aim over this long, overriding layers.fade_s for the head (0.3-0.35 s for body parts in the animation literature).

face.note: latency_s: the head server's hop; its 280 ms tween (config/face.json timing) starts after it. fade_s: a face changes in about 0.1 s, faster than a body part; overrides layers.fade_s for the face.

body.note: fade_s: overrides layers.fade_s for the wheels. The wheels' expressive motions on the board's measured-motion path, never Nav2, only while the goal server says navigating false: a turn in place of at most max_turn_deg per request in steps of step_deg, a rock of at most max_rock_m. A stalled wheel or a blocked arc (lidar, ToF) backs the cart off backoff_m and the turn is tried again, at most attempts times and max_backoff_m of backing in all; then it gives up and the head looks as far as it reaches.

doa.note: The XVF3800 sits on the cart's front, not on the head. front_deg: the array's angle (0..359, 0 toward its USB-C side) of a voice straight ahead of the cart; sign: +1 when that angle grows toward the cart's left, -1 toward its right. Both null until measured (scratch/audio/doa_turn.py --calibrate: one phrase three times each at 1.5 m in front, left, behind and right; it prints the two numbers and refuses four readings that are not 90 +- 15 deg apart); null orients by faces alone (the head tilts to seek_tilt_deg where it points and looks for a face). window_s: the speech-flagged readings of the utterance's last window_s (the utterance's end mapped onto the board's clock by the newest reading) are averaged (circular mean) into its bearing; fewer than min_speech of them (about 10 a second arrive) and the voice has no bearing.

speaker.note: comfort_pan_deg: the head alone turns this far; past it the wheels turn the rest (parts.body), and the head goes to its reach when they may not. in_frame_deg: a voice this close to where the head points is in the picture already: no pan, only the tilt to seek_tilt_deg and a frame. seek_tilt_deg: the tilt the head turns to before a face is found (+ down; level-ish for a face at 1-2 m; home's 23.8 deg down would leave a standing face out of the 59 deg tall picture). seek_frames, seek_every_s: frames taken at that interval after the turn before giving up on a face (the head then stays on the voice and keeps one frame every track_every_s). track_every_s: one frame this often while the conversation lasts, the head stands still, is the speaker's and carries no gesture (a breath does not count). match_deg: a face within this of the voice's bearing is the speaker's; with none, the face nearest the frame's centre, the widest on a tie. refine_deg: after a turn, a face further than this off the frame's centre is centred (G3 wants it within 5 deg). deadband_deg: while tracking, a face this close to the frame's centre moves nothing. saccade_over_deg: a correction larger than this is a saccade, a smaller one the arbiter's slow speed (slow_deg_s, 20). doa_jump_deg: an utterance whose voice is this far from the person held turns the head to it again (the array names the loudest voice; one overlapping the robot's own speech is ignored). ttl_s, renew_s: the speaker's look lives ttl_s and is renewed every renew_s, so the head goes home within ttl_s of the cascade's end; a renewal that finds the look gone (a look the person asked for took the head) asks again, queued behind it. aim_wait_s: how long an aim waits for the arbiter's answer before it is taken as queued. smile, smile_hold_s: the face's expression (source expression, through the head server) when a face is first found in a conversation, once, and for how long; smile_unseen: smile also when no face is found (off: a smile at nobody).
